definition: FactiveKnowledge Knows requires that for every agent a and proposition p, Knows a p entails p. The predicate Knows is otherwise unconstrained: no knowledge is asserted to exist. Factivity is explicit in the theorem rather than silently inferred from assertion.
note: A stipulative factive-knowledge profile, not a sourced empirical premise. A nonfactive relation named Knows is tested as an omission control.
